Commentary.Commentary: Right then, it's a wrap from this high-octane clash where India has clinically defeated Bangladesh and have disrupted their campaign and have leapfrogged as the table toppers in Group 1 with back-to-back wins. India will now head to Barbados for a tough test against Australia. While Bangladesh will battle it out against Afghanistan. Well, the Super-8s have served nail-biting thrillers and have been up to the expectations. Next up is one of the most awaited clashes in the Super-8s. It will be Australia battling it out against Afghanistan. Would Afghanistan have recovered from the wounds the Aussies gave them in the ODI World Cup? We shall find out soon enough. The game will be played on Sunday, 23rd June and the first ball will be bowled at 6 am IST (12.30 am GMT). Till then, take care!

The captain of India, Rohit Sharma says that they know what is expected of them and it is about showing out there on the field. Feels that his team adapted to the conditions quickly. Adds that is about being smart in using the options that you have. Opines that you don't need 50s and 100s in T20 cricket and what matters is how you put the pressure on the bowlers. States that the way Hardik Pandya batted in this game puts them in very good stead and they know what he is capable of. Says that they need Hardik to finish games off for them after the platform is laid by the top 5.

Najmul Hossain Shanto, the skipper of Bangladesh is up for a chat. He says they were looking to restrict India to around 160 but credits them for batting aggressively towards the back end. He thinks that they had a lot of batting options but didn't display the required intent. Adds that when you have 190 odd to chase, you need to go hard in the Powerplay. He says all the batters were well-prepared for the conditions. About his batting, he says that he is trying to bat well every game.

Hardik Pandya is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his all-round brilliance. He says that they have played some really good cricket. Adds that they have stuck together as a team and have stuck to the plans. Further says that guys have stepped up in crunch situations in the tournament so far. Shares that it was important to not let the batters use the breeze and make it tough for them to hit with the wind. Feels that losing wickets in clumps is something they want to avoid going ahead. Tells that he had a freak injury during the ODI World Cup and tried to come back but god had other plans.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, India was inserted to bat first. Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli, who were due for runs, provided a very steady and solid opening stand as both got off the blocks pretty early and negotiated the Powerplay overs playing good strokes. Virat Kohli played some colossal hits and settled well. Rohit Sharma struck a couple of sixes but couldn't extend his innings and perished on 23 off just 11. Virat Kohli then got out on 37 and Suryakumar Yadav too followed without wreaking any damage. But those quick wickets didn't bother Rishabh Pant at all who continued with his magnificent form and inflated the scoring rate without breaking a sweat. But it was Hardik who stayed till the end with a quickfire cameo half-century helping India to mount 196 on the board. Into the chase, Bangladesh got a good start but they failed to capitalise in the mid-overs and kept losing wickets. Najmul Hossain Shanto kept fighting but in the end, the Indian bowlers totally got on top and didn't give any respite to them.

India had a pretty good score on the board, but they knew they had to snag some wickets quickly to really put the squeeze on Bangladesh. Hardik Pandya stepped up big time with a crucial wicket when they needed it most. Bangladesh could've been in even deeper trouble if Pant hadn't shelled an easy catch of Tanzid. Once the fielding restrictions eased up, the spinners started messing with the batters' heads. They made it super tough to score and really cranked up the pressure. The pitch was acting up too with variable bounce and also slowed down as the innings progressed. Kuldeep Yadav cashed in on this, snagging three wickets and barely giving away any runs in his four overs. Then Bumrah came back for round two and turned the screws even more with another wicket. Arshdeep Singh got in on the action too, picking up a couple of scalps of his own. Bumrah ended up with brilliant figures yet again, bowling four overs of pure misery for the batters. He gave away practically nothing, with more than a ton of dot balls and two wickets.

Bangladesh started their chase pretty smoothly. Tanzid Hasan and Litton Das were handling the Indian fast bowlers well, smacking a few good shots to the boundary. Litton Das was looking good with some nice hits, but then he got out sooner. After Litton's departure, the scoring rate drastically took a hit after the first six overs. Tanzid Hasan who got off to a sedate start couldn't extend his innings and got out on 29. Najmul Hossain Shanto then sailed Bangladesh through the mid-overs but a couple of batters perished from the other end. Towhid Hridoy couldn't do much with the bat and neither could Shakib Al Hasan. These two quick blows dented Bangladesh's hopes but the skipper, Shanto tried to ease off the pressure and found some boundaries but eventually got out on a well-made 40. And after his fall, Bangladesh badly struggled and kept losing wickets. Rishad Hossain and Mahmudullah stitched a good partnership striking a few boundaries and sixes but they were left with plenty to chase, and in the end, they just fell like a house of cards.

INDIA HAS CRUSHED BANGLADESH, BEATING THEM BY 50 RUNS! This is the second win for India in the Super 8s and they maintain their dominance over their neighbouring counterparts in T20 World Cups. A clinical performance overall in all three departments by the Men in Blue. This win will surely inflate their NRR to a huge extent on the Points Table in Group 1. And if Australia beats Afghanistan in their next game, India will qualify for the semi-finals as will Australia.

That's it! India go 2 from 2 in the Super 8s! Another off-pace delivery by Arshdeep Singh, on a length, on off and middle, Tanzim Hasan Sakib makes room and punches it down to long off for a single. INDIA WIN BY 50 RUNS!

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.4: Hardik Pandya to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Off-pace this time and into the wicket, on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto makes room and knocks it with a flat bat in front of mid off for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.3: Hardik Pandya to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Najmul Hossain Shanto takes the short ball on and gets the reward! Hardik bends his back and directs it at the batter, Najmul Hossain Shanto fetches the hook shot from over his head and hits it over fine leg for a biggie. A boundary after 24 balls for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.2: Hardik Pandya to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Rolls his fingers over the ball and lands it on a good length, on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto makes room but can only play this one back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.1: Hardik Pandya to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pushes it through, short and on middle, Tanzid Hasan is rushed on the pull and gets an inside edge onto the pads. A tidy start from Kuldeep Yadav.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.6: Kuldeep Yadav to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto fetches the pull from outside off and hits it to deep mid-wicket for just a single. 50 up for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.5: Kuldeep Yadav to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Keeps it away from the reach of the batter, short and near the wide guideline, Najmul Hossain Shanto reaches out and pats it to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.4: Kuldeep Yadav to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Keeps it near the tramline on off, short and turning away, Tanzid Hasan drags the pull down to deep mid-wicket for one more run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.3: Kuldeep Yadav to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, that kept very low! Slower and shorter, turning away, on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto adjusts well to the bounce and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.2: Kuldeep Yadav to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Starts off short and gets a bit of extra bounce, on middle and leg, it holds in the surface too. Najmul Hossain Shanto rocks back for the pull but misses as he goes through his shot early and wears it on the body.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.1: Kuldeep Yadav to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Angling across, short and wide on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto slaps it down to deep point for just a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.6: Ravindra Jadeja to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Drops it short again, on middle, Tanzid Hasan hangs back and nudges it through mid-wicket for one more run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.5: Ravindra Jadeja to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fires it in at the pads again, on a good length, Tanzid Hasan tries to use the pace but fails to do and wears it on the pad.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Ravindra Jadeja to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and at the stumps, Najmul Hossain Shanto steps out to go back over the bowler's head but miscues it off the inside edge to deep backward square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Ravindra Jadeja to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! Too straight, short and on the pads, Tanzid Hasan misses the tickle and the ball brushes his pads and rolls wide of short fine leg for a leg bye.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Ravindra Jadeja to Tanzid Hasan, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Starts off on a nagging length, on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto rocks back and pulls it to the left of long on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Ravindra Jadeja to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Straight and cannoned full in length, in front of the stumps, Tanzid Hasan prods forward and solidly defends it down the deck. End of the mandatory Powerplay. Bangladesh are 43/1.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Jasprit Bumrah to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full this time and it is outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto reaches out for the drive but gets an outside edge that flies down to deep third for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Jasprit Bumrah to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Takes pace off and keeps it full as well, on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto waits on it and defends it out on the off side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Jasprit Bumrah to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hurls it on a back of a length, on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto gets on top of the bounce and pushes it to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Jasprit Bumrah to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! Rishabh Pant puts it down! That should have been taken! Jasprit Bumrah has his hands on his head in disbelief. Angling away, on a hard length, zipping through, on off, Tanzid Hasan fiddles at the delivery and gets an outside edge that travels quickly to Rishabh Pant who gets his gloves in the correct position but fails to hang on as the ball comes on faster than he expected. It bursts through his gloves and rolls behind for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Jasprit Bumrah to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, Bumrah is lucky to get away with that! The ball slips off Bumrah's hand and ends up serving a waist-high full toss, outside off, Tanzid Hasan dabs it wide of point for a couple of runs. The replays indicate that the ball was just above the waist but the umpire thought otherwise.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Jasprit Bumrah to Tanzid Hasan, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: On the back of a length, and outside off, Tanzid Hasan punches it to deep covers for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Hardik Pandya to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length around leg, Tanzid Hasan punches it down to mid on off the back foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Hardik Pandya to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Sprays it onto the pads, on a fullish length, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks it to deep square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Hardik Pandya to Najmul Hossain Shanto, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Down leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto fails to connect the flick shot. Wide given.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Hardik Pandya to Najmul Hossain Shanto, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Najmul Hossain Shanto walks in at number 3.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Good comeback from Hardik and India get the first breakthrough! Litton Das will be distraught! Hardik takes pace off and bowls a good-length delivery outside off. Litton Das shuffles way outside off, half-squats at it and does not go through with the pull shot. He slices the pull shot only as far as Suryakumar Yadav patrolling the deep square leg fence, who runs across to his left and dives in front to take a safe catch. Hardik strikes in his first over.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Hardik Pandya
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Hardik Pandya to Litton Das, OUT! c Suryakumar Yadav b Hardik Pandya.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Pulled away neatly! Good length, on the top of off, Litton Das stands tall, creates a strong base for him, and pulls it on the up and gets it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Hardik Pandya to Litton Das, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Sees the batter advancing down the track, Hardik delivers it closer to the batter and cramps him for room on the leg stump line, Tanzid Hasan looks to work it away on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads and it rolls to the off side for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Hardik Pandya to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! False start from Hardik! Bangs it short and it flies over the batter's head for a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Hardik Pandya to Tanzid Hasan, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Hardik Pandya comes into the attack now.

FOUR! Nice placement! Axar Patel changes the angle and comes from around the wicket. Delivers on a very full length, around off, Litton Das sits on his knee and sweeps it to perfection beating the diving square leg fielder to his right for a boundary. Bangladesh off to a steady start.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Axar Patel to Litton Das, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around off, Tanzid Hasan drives it with soft hands down to long on for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Axar Patel to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Slows it on a fuller length, at the stumps, Litton Das moves away from the line of the ball and drives it through mid off for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Axar Patel to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up full and on leg, Tanzid Hasan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Axar Patel to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good shot! Bowls it short in length, and outside off, Tanzid Hasan reads it early, transfers the weight quickly on the back foot and pulls it well wide of deep mid-wicket for four more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Axar Patel to Tanzid Hasan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Over the wicket, full and outside off, Tanzid Hasan looks to shovel it out but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Axar Patel to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Tanzid Hasan cuts it to deep point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the hard length, on off, Tanzid Hasan defends it to covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good-length delivery outside off, Tanzid Hasan hangs back and attempts to cut it away but gets it off the bottom half of the bat into the turf and the ball bounces over a leaping Virat Kohli at second slip and races away for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Around off and shaping away from the batter, Tanzid Hasan presses ahead and defends it to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Shade short and moving away from outside off, Tanzid Hasan goes for a cut shot but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nice shot! Fuller and swinging away from outside off, Tanzid Hasan gets the desired width, shimmies down the track and drives it uppishly past Ravindra Jadeja stationed at point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: An appeal for caught behind but just for a brief moment. Jasprit Bumrah lands it on a good length, outside the off-stump line, Litton Das pokes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge. Rishabh Pant collects the ball just a few inches above the grass diving forward.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Jasprit Bumrah to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Swings it away on a fuller length, outside off. Litton Das doesn't move his feet at all and goes for an expansive drive through covers but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Jasprit Bumrah to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it on a good length, angling on the middle and leg to the right-hander, Litton Das closes the bat's face a bit early trying to flick it away through the leg side, and gets it off the outside half of the bat to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Jasprit Bumrah to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes fuller this time, on the middle and leg corridor, Tanzid Hasan prods ahead and steers it to deep backward square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Jasprit Bumrah to Tanzid Hasan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Stays over the wicket, bowls it on a good length, outside off and gets a bit of more bounce, Litton Das adjusts the shot and manages it to dab it past backward point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Jasprit Bumrah to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bumrah starts from over the wicket, and delivers it on the money straight away! Full and angling on off, Litton Das covers the off stump and dabs it to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Jasprit Bumrah to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Jasprit Bumrah.

Bowls a tight line and length, closer to the off-pole. Tanzid Hasan hops on the back foot to knock it to the off side but gets it off the toe-end of the bat and rolls behind towards Pant who makes a sharp stop moving away to his left. First over done, 5 runs from it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! First boundary of the chase! Short and wide of off with an away movement, Tanzid Hasan clears the inner ring off the back foot cutting it square over the leaping point fielder for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Swings it away again, full and outside off, Tanzid Hasan eases it in front of covers on the front foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Another conventional outswinger on a fullish length, outside off, Tanzid Hasan goes to poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Swings away from the left-hander on a length, outside off, Tanzid Hasan watches the ball closely and decides not to offer any shot at it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Arshdeep Singh to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Litton Das is off the mark with a single! Arshdeep Singh lands it on a good length, tailing into the batter on the pads, Litton Das flicks it towards deep backward square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Arshdeep Singh to Litton Das, 1 run.
